name: Workflow 7 - OmniGuard Lead Capture (Webhook -> Supabase -> Gmail -> Telegram)

nodes.name: OmniGuard Lead Webhook
nodes.notes: Expects JSON body: { name, email, company, message }. Matches the fields submitted by omni-guard-site/lead-form.html.

nodes.name: Insert Lead (Supabase)
nodes.notes: Requires the `message` column added by automation/supabase-omniguard-leads-update.sql. Uses the `leads` table from automation/supabase-tables.sql — same table as Workflow 2, distinguished by source = 'omniguard-site'.

parameters.subject: We received your security inquiry
parameters.message:
Hi {{ $('Insert Lead (Supabase)').item.json.name }},

Thanks for reaching out to OmniGuard. We've logged your inquiry and a member of the team will follow up shortly.

— The OmniGuard Team

nodes.name: Send Confirmation Email
nodes.notes: Anonymous sign-off per CLAUDE.md zero-bleed rules — OmniGuard never surfaces Derek's name or personal contact info to end users.

nodes.name: Notify Derek (Telegram)
nodes.notes: chatId is a placeholder — Derek must replace it with his real Telegram chat ID (message @userinfobot on Telegram to get it) and attach a Telegram Bot credential before activating.
